title: You Look Like a Thing and I Love You
description: As heard on NPR’s “Science Friday,” discover the book recommended by Malcolm Gladwell, Susan Cain, Daniel Pink, and Adam Grant: an “accessible, informative, and hilarious” introduction to the weird and wonderful world of artificial intelligence (Ryan North).You look like a thing and I love you is one of the best pickup lines ever… according to an artificial intelligence trained by scientist Janelle Shane, creator ...
